sources.title: OpenMed / OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-BiomedELECTRA-Base-110M-v1
sources.snippet: This is a compact Portuguese-language model for detecting personally identifiable information (PII) in biomedical and clinical text. It is based on BiomedELECTRA and performs token-classification tasks such as finding patient names, dates, identifiers and contact details so that sensitive data can be redacted or anonymised. sources.title: OpenMed — local-first clinical AI
sources.snippet: OpenMed 2.2.0 · on-device clinical AI Your data. Your model. Your iPhone. OpenMed reads clinical text and removes 55+ PHI types on the hardware you control, so patient data never leaves the device. 2,000+ Apache-2.0 models, 33 model-backed PII languages, state of the art on 10 of 12 biomedical NER benchmarks — and a new release most weeks.
